snippet.title: Guinea Pig Runaway Together - Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Guinea Pig Runaway Together is a physics-based parkour game where you control a balloon full of adorable guinea pigs.

Play solo, team up with friends inside the same balloon, or compete against rival balloons in Race Mode. Work together and you can overcome anything. Lose coordination, and the balloon probably isn’t going anywhere.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4244190/Guinea_Pig_Runaway_Together/

Streamers featured in this video:
- Kiitarie
- SanguineElegance
- flowerdragon13
- OLLYROBZ
- TommyDime
- skippysm0m
- Game Lens
